title: Hierarchical Meta-Learning for Cancer Pathway Signatures: A Novel Framework for Few-Shot Cancer Type Discovery

contributions.purpose: 为癌症基因组学做少样本分类
contributions.mechanism: 三层生物层级(器官系统→组织学→分子亚型)的 hierarchical MAML + pathway-aware attention
contributions.source_quote: We design the first hierarchical meta-learning framework for cancer genomics, incorporating a three-level hierarchy

contributions.purpose: 提升可解释性并聚焦生物相关基因集
contributions.mechanism: pathway-aware attention 对 32 条通路加权
contributions.evaluation: top 通路 oxphos_program(1.328)/Jak1_vivo_ko/proliferating;文献相关性 Pearson 0.78,p<0.001
contributions.source_quote: We develop pathway-aware attention mechanisms that focus learning on biologically relevant gene sets

contributions.purpose: 量化跨癌种通路可迁移性
contributions.mechanism: 基于通路重要性排名差的迁移相似度度量
contributions.evaluation: 代谢通路高迁移(>0.8),发育通路低迁移(<0.5)
contributions.source_quote: We establish a quantitative framework for measuring pathway transferability across cancer types

notes: 自声明 4 条贡献,归并为 3(第4条为TCGA验证,并入C1评估)。多处数据红旗:(1)全文正文引用全部渲染为'?'(\cite 全部损坏);(2)Fig4 文字称'high concordance'但图内自标 best fit R²≈0.27(与文字矛盾);(3)'高判别通路'Jak1_vivo_ko、Flcn_vitro_ko 实为小鼠基因敲除实验名而非人类通路,疑似标签错配/占位;(4)baseline 比较逐 shot 换对手(1-shot 比 MAML、5-shot 比 transfer、10-shot 比 prototypical)为择优对比;(5)checklist 自称有 error bars 与统计显著性[Yes],但 Results 全为单点数字未见误差棒;(6)代码未开源(承诺接收后放)。checklist AI 披露:假设/实验/分析 B,写作 C(AI 主导起草)。非负结果论文;trade-off 未明确量化。
